name: Push-Up
instructions: Keep your body straight, lower your chest to the floor, then push back up.

name: Bench Press
instructions: Lower the bar to mid-chest with control, then press it back up over your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: With a slight bend in the elbows, open your arms wide and bring the weights back together over your chest.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then stand up.

name: Back Squat
instructions: With the bar on your upper back, squat to depth while keeping your chest up.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor, then step through with the other leg.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, lowering the bar along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar and pull until your chin clears it, then lower with control.

name: Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge forward and row the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace one hand on a bench and row the dumbbell to your hip.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Drive through your feet and stand up with the bar, keeping it close to your body and your back neutral.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Press the bar from your shoulders to overhead, locking out your arms.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells out to your sides until your arms are parallel to the floor.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: With your hips high in an inverted V, lower your head toward the floor and press back up.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Curl the dumbbells up without swinging, then lower them slowly.

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees, then press back up.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lying on a bench, bend at the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, then extend.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms, bracing your abs.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar and raise your legs to hip height or higher without swinging.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit leaning back with your feet up and rotate the weight from side to side.
